meta.title: Find a draft event or project — it is on the Drafts tab
gaps: Whether every saved field and value is preserved when the draft reopens
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Whether every saved field and value is preserved when the draft reopens

plan.title: Find a saved draft on the Drafts tab

steps.note: Create the draft event under test.
Provide the title used to search for the draft.
Use an RFQ stage so the event has a concrete draft configuration.
Apply the pricing template before adding items.
Add a line item to verify saved draft content.
Complete the pricing sheet so the draft has saved sheet data.
Commit a schedule required for the draft setup.
Add participants to make the draft a usable event configuration.
Save the configured event as a draft.
Return to the events list to find the saved draft.
Confirm the list rendered before searching.
Open the Drafts tab specified by the case.
Assert the draft appears on the Drafts tab.
Assert the matching row carries a Draft badge.
Check that the draft is not listed under Live.
Assert the draft title is absent from the Live tab.
Check that the draft is not listed under History.
Assert the draft title is absent from the History tab.
Check that the draft is not listed under Recurring.
Assert the draft title is absent from the Recurring tab.
Return to Drafts to reopen the saved event.
Open the matching draft; drafts reopen on the create screen.
Assert that opening the draft returns to the create screen.
Verify the selected template was preserved.
Verify the saved line item was preserved.
Confirm the reopened draft has no application error.
